caseNameFull: Otis Elevator Company v. Lois Hoskins and Hotel Randolph Company
attorneys: Messrs. Edwin W. Sims,. Elwood G. Godman. and James L. Coleman for petitioner. Messrs. Joseph G. Gamble, Donald Evans, Clifford B. Cox and Wm. F. Riley for respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of the State of Iowa denied. The Chief Justice took no part in the consideration or decision of the petition for a writ of certiorari in this case.
